channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Sarawak man shoots neighbour dead at longhouse, police arrest
item.description: A 43-year-old longhouse man was arrested after allegedly shooting dead a 69-year-old neighbour in Julau

item.title: “Tolerance or consideration?” — Man calls police over Bai Tian Gong fireworks, internet reacts
item.description: A man’s noise complaint during Bai Tian Gong fireworks in KL sparks debate online, with netizens divided over tolerance, law and consideration.

item.title: Johor consumers back food labelling at Ramadan bazaars for safety
item.description: Labelling food at Ramadan bazaars can protect consumers and curb food poisoning, with Johor residents calling for greater transparency from traders.

item.title: Rohingya man charged with murder of pregnant wife in Kota Tinggi
item.description: A Rohingya man faces murder and culpable homicide charges for the death of his pregnant wife and unborn child in a Kota Tinggi case.

item.title: High court dismisses Petros challenge to RM7.95 million bank guarantee
item.description: The High Court in Kuching dismissed Petroleum Sarawak Bhd's bid to block a RM7.95 million bank guarantee claim by Petronas, ordering Petros to pay legal costs.

item.title: Malaysia to finalise social media age verification rules by mid-year
item.description: The government aims to finalise mandatory age checks for social media users by Q2 2025, with platforms facing RM10 million fines for non-compliance.

item.title: M’sian teen treats family to dinner with first salary
item.description: Teen celebrates first salary by treating family to Thai dinner, sparking heartfelt wishes and inspiring others online

item.title: MOHE urges calm as UMPSA Quran case probed
item.description: Authorities investigate viral Quran desecration incident; MCMC, police act under existing laws.

item.title: DAP reaffirms call for RCI into MACC “corporate mafia” claims
item.description: DAP chairman Gobind Singh Deo backs a Royal Commission of Inquiry to probe ‘corporate mafia’ allegations against MACC, citing need for transparency.

item.title: Shell Malaysia offers prizes of up to RM 135k in 135th anniversary contest
item.description: Shell Malaysia marks its 135th anniversary this year with RM 1.35 million worth of prizes through a nationwide contest, designed to enhance customers’ everyday journeys. Shell has also expanded its high-performance Electric Vehicle (EV) charging network with Shell Recharge to support Malaysia’s growing EV community, while Shell claims its Lubricants has been named the world’s No.1 Global Lubricants Supplier for 19 consecutive years.
